Game Overview

In Robot Run, the core idea is straightforward: navigate through a perilous tech lab, dodging lasers and obstacles. In Robot Run, experience the thrill of endless escape as a newly assembled robot with an unyielding desire for freedom. Can you outsmart the high-tech defenses and make it to the open world beyond?
